en: Black‑and‑white postcard view of a two‑storey inn or guesthouse with arched windows and a hipped roof, set along a tree‑lined road. An early automobile is parked in front and a person with a bicycle stands by the wall. The building bears signage above the entrance, and handwritten script at the bottom identifies the place as a guesthouse named Alt‑Kella near a location called Nößten (or Nossen). The setting appears rural or small‑town and the image has an early‑20th‑century look.
